title: 6am cake pickup near Vineyard and Box Hill — before the school run
summary:
Vineyard and Box Hill start early. So do we.

Riverstone opens 6am weekdays — before most Sydney bakeries unlock the door. Order your custom eggless cake with 48 hours notice, then pick it up on the way to work or the school run, not around it.

Six sizes. Fifteen flavours. Every cake 100% eggless, every time. Free parking at the shopping centre.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725 to lock in your pickup slot.
